question: Why does accomplishing one syllable of the mother-of-letters accomplish that likewise?
premises: The verse concerns one syllable of the mother-of-letters.
It says that becomes accomplished thus.
Accomplishment of part implies accomplishment of whole.
inference: Perfection of a single letter-syllable brings corresponding perfection.
uncertainties: The exact correspondence between syllable and result is not specified.
plain_english: When even one syllable of the mother-of-letters is accomplished, that too is accomplished thus.
